notes.title: Possible Connection Issues After October 1, 2025
notes.content:
Greetings, Brinehunters!



We’ve recently been informed of an upcoming change from Epic Online Services (EOS), the platform that powers our online features. Starting October 1, 2025, some Windows players using older EOS versions (including the one currently used by Abyssus) may experience connection issues.



What does this mean for you?



If your Windows system is fully updated, you should be fine.

If you encounter errors, you can fix them by either: 
[olist]
Installing the latest Windows Updates (recommended).

Manually installing the new security certificate (see below for the full runthrough).
[/olist]


We’re already working on updating Abyssus to the latest EOS SDK. This will ensure long-term stability and prevent these issues altogether.




[hr][/hr]


Manual Certificate Installation (Windows)



If you experience connection issues after October 1, 2025 and updating Windows doesn’t solve it, you can manually install the required security certificate by following these steps:
[olist]
Open the Start menu → type cmd.

Right-click on "Command Prompt" and select "Run as Administrator".

Copy and paste the following command into the window, then press Enter:
[/olist]
curl https://account-public-service-prod03.ol.epicgames.com/account/

     4. Once the process completes, restart your computer.

     5. Relaunch Abyssus and try connecting again.



⚠️ Note: This method is only needed if Windows Updates are not applied or do not work. The easiest and safest solution remains updating Windows regularly.



- The DoubleMoose Team

notes.title: Roadmap Blog
notes.content:
Greetings, Brinehunters!

Thank you for being with us during the launch of Abyssus. We’re very happy to see so many of you enjoying the game! 



We want to reiterate our post-launch plans:

We have a lot of post-launch content planned, and all of it will be free.



We will never sell new content such as new weapons, abilities, game modes, etc. The only DLCs that will be paid for are supporter packs that add cosmetics and emotes. People can buy these if they want to support us as a studio, but it will never be required to get the latest, coolest stuff we’ve added to the game. 



Here’s a brief preview of the updates we’re working on:


Infinite Mode: lets you continue playing indefinitely until you feel ready to face the final boss, with enemies infinitely scaling. We are excited to see who can make the most broken build and reach the furthest depths!

Random Order Mode: keeps things fresh by switching up the areas so they’re not always in the same order. If you play with Random Order Mode on, you might start in Area 3, then go to Area 1, and so on. It will take some balance work to get it right, but we think this will be appreciated by those who play the game the most.

Alternative boss patterns: new movesets for the bosses, so you never really know which ones you’ll get in your next expedition.



Of course, we’ll also be adding new weapons, weapon mods, abilities, and some more secret stuff we want to keep as a surprise. 



After the 1.1 and 1.2 patches, we will take a step back, listen to community feedback, and figure out what our next updates should be.


We don’t want to reveal everything right now, but we want our players to know that we intend to keep updating Abyssus according to your feedback and to what we think will make the best game in the long run. 

We love this game, and we love working on it. So, if you have any suggestions, feedback, or ideas, please leave a comment below!



We also just released a new hotfix. Read more here : [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1721110/view/523100258247376997"][/dynamiclink]
- The DoubleMoose Team

notes.title: HOTFIX NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Greetings, Brinehunters!

We just applied a new hotfix to Abyssus, intended to solve some of the issues reported since the launch of the game.
We are still working on your feedback, and we will roll out further fixes as we investigate and take action on the different issues you report.
Please keep in mind that in order to apply the fix, Abyssus must be closed and restarted. Moreover, you won’t be able to join the sessions of players who have not downloaded it yet.

 BUG FIXES:

Optimized Gauge should now correctly increase shotgun damage after a Boss has been frozen or slowed.

After rejoining a lobby, some of the animated objectives no longer appear frozen.

Players should no longer get stuck in the Diving Bell after defeating Secret Phase To'raka.

Fixed a crash happening when equipping a loadout without getting a savegame.

Fixed a crash happening when accepting session invites without a valid unique NetID

Dying during the Secret Phase To'raka countdown should no longer cause visual issues.

The Diving Bell no longer appears during To'raka's second phase.

The “Weapon Mastery” challenge should now be completed as intended.

The “Speedster” challenge can now be completed correctly

The “Collector” challenge should now work as intended and should be retroactively awarded to players who completed all weapons and abilities.

The “Turret Mastery” and “Unstable Cores” challenges should now work as intended.

The “No Need” challenge should now also work with syringes not obtained during the run.

Spark Orbs should now have the right color in multiplayer.

The Plasma Launcher projectiles’ color is now consistent with primary/secondary fire.

The New Monarch challenge should now give the correct notification once unlocked.

Stable String stacks no longer reset when an enemy dies.

Players should no longer take damage when entering a new zone.

Enemies should no longer get stuck in walls.

Players should no longer trigger an infinite loading screen on ALT-TAB.

It is now possible to switch tabs with RB and LB after changing languages.

Players should no longer get stuck in the Workbench by dashing into it as it's opening.

The hole in the Royal Gardens’ Flooded Hamlet should now be easier to get out of.

Players should no longer be able to die after defeating Secret Phase To'raka.

Diver Suit's left arm no longer appears deformed on the camera.

The indicator for when Automatic Action and Trigger mutators are active should now appear correctly.

The Unstable Core mod should now stun enemies as intended.

Execute now counts as a melee attack for the “Unbeatable” challenge

Explosive Culling mod should now increase damage based on missing enemy health as intended.

Power from Pain buff should now update correctly.

Accelerating Core should no longer increase range when shooting in quick succession.

Fixed some controller-related issues:

Players can now move right when viewing Expeditions with a controller.

Players should now be able to view profiles and access all the relevant options when playing on a controller.

Players should no longer get stuck in the Helmet selection in the Wardrobe when using a controller.

Various crash fixes

 

BALANCE CHANGES:

Increased the damage on the Shotgun primary fire

The health of To'raka’s invulnerability spheres has been reduced.

The health of Unglu’s Surgezones and Crystals has been reduced.

Increased the timer before the “sudden death” in To’raka’s secret phase and slightly lowered Toraka’s health during this phase.

The speed of the Elite Berserker has been reduced.  

RichGetRicher - Reduced chance from 15->10 %

Slightly increased the timeframe to beat the Combat Bow challenge

notes.title: NEW HOTFIX LANDING NEXT WEEK!
notes.content:
Greetings, Brinehunters! As your feedback flows in, we are hard at work on your reports to make the Abyssus experience as smooth and polished as it can be.


We are currently testing a new hotfix that we'll deploy next week. This latest update will fix some of the issues you reported, and notably:

- Progression blockers and “stuck” scenarios 
- notably during the To’raka fight, the Workbench, or in environmental hazards.

- Visual and animation glitches (frozen objectives, incorrect projectile or orb colors, deformed models, missing indicators).

- Weapon and mod functionalities that are not working as intended.

- Controller navigation and menu accessibility.

- Boss and encounters balancing.

We'll publish more details with the full changelog early next week. In the meantime, we want to reiterate our thanks for your feedback, for enjoying Abyssus, and for helping us make it better day after day!

- The DoubleMoose Team

notes.title: ABYSSUS LAUNCHES AUGUST 12 – NEW STEAM NEXT FEST DEMO IS LIVE!
notes.content:
Listen up, Brinehunters!

We know you’ve been itching for adventure, and our first demo wasn’t enough to fill your cravings for iron, steam, and brine. We heard you, and we’re thrilled to reveal that you’ll be able to plunge into the full depths of the Abyss on August 12, 2025!

But be careful. In the deepest fathoms of the sea, now one will hear you scream – so you’d better prepare for your expedition. 
Lucky for you, we’ve cooked you the perfect training program.

Discover what awaits you in our Release Date Trailer:
[previewyoutube=vnAWfATPH3I;full][/previewyoutube]
A New Demo Surfaces!
To be sure you’re prepared for your upcoming dive on August 12, we’ve come up with a brand-new expedition:
Dive into the all-new Gardens biome, a lush yet haunting domain where aquatic guardians stand ready to defend the ruins of their lost civilization from intruders.

And since the challenges will be tougher than before, we’ve got you covered with a brand-new, electrifying weapon: the Tesla rifle! Its electric power can be concentrated onto a target or arc among the enemies, delivering devastating bursts of damage to tightly packed enemies. Its true potential is unleashed through secondary mods, enabling powerful charged attacks. 

The Tesla Gun will be joining the arsenal you’re already familiar with:

 The Brine Revolver: A masterfully crafted semi-automatic sidearm designed for reliable critical strikes. Built for precision and power, the primary fire mode excels in close-quarters combat, delivering consistent damage to deal with nearby enemies, while the secondary fire lets you pick off distant foes while aiming down its sight.
 The Engine Rifle: A powerhouse of the depths, the Engine Rifle earns its name from its fiery temper. Use your secondary weapon to rev the engine into overdrive, unleashing bursts of raw power while pushing heat levels to the brink.
 The Shotgun: A true staple of any FPS arsenal, this juggernaut is built to deliver sheer devastation at close range. Unleash a relentless spread of bullets that tear through guardians with raw stopping power.

Gather your crew. It’s time to face the depths of the Abyss one more time.

notes.title: ABYSSUS ALPHA OPENS TOMORROW!
notes.content:
Gather your friends and dive into the unknown with Abyssus, a wild and exciting “Brinepunk” Roguelike FPS that drops you right into the depths of an ancient underwater city.
Get ready for non-stop action, tons of customization, and a one-of-a-kind underwater adventure!

Discover the Announcement Trailer: 
[previewyoutube=Nde1ob2AqqQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Explore the Abyss. Master its Power. Survive its Depths.
In a world powered by brine –a rare and powerful substance only found in the deepest fathoms of the sea, your team of mercenary explorers is recruited to retrieve a massive deposit located beneath the ruins of a long-lost civilization. Nice and easy, right? It would be, if it weren't for the corrupted, bloodthirsty inhabitants lurking within this sunken kingdom. 

Team up with fellow Brinehunters, uncover the ocean's forgotten secrets, and blast your way through hordes of corrupted enemies!💥

🌊 Will you survive to see the surface again, or will the Abyss claim your life?

Gear Up. Wield Godly Powers. Go Deeper Into the Abyss. Die. Repeat.
Your best chance to survive in Abyssus is by mastering the ocean of weapon and character customization. Run after run, unlock new gear, and carefully choose synergic loadouts, skills, suits, and weapon mods to progress deeper into the Abyss.

And, who knows? You and your team of Brinehunters might be fortunate enough to receive blessings from divine forces…

The Abyss is Waiting for You
Wanna take a dive and face the Abyss? We've got you covered! 
We're launching an Alpha, which you can join anytime while it's live by clicking on the opt-in button on the game's store page!

Check out the dates:

 Friday, December 6 (3PM CET) - Monday, December 9 (3PM CET)
 Friday, December 13 (3PM CET) - Monday, December 16 (3PM CET)
 Friday, December 20 (3PM CET) - Monday, December 23 (3PM CET)


Important note on progression
Your progression won't be wiped during these playtest sessions. You’ll be able to come back, pick up right where you left off, and continue to explore the Abyss throughout the Alpha phases.

Dive into the Alpha:
Wondering what awaits you at the bottom of the ocean? Well, be ready for:

 Solo or Co-op Experience: Dive into the depths solo or team up with up to three of your buddies!
 Luxuriant and mysterious ruins: Explore and survive in two areas swarmed by corrupted ennemies
 Two Boss Battles and Miniboss Fights: Challenge yourself against some tough opponents.
 Powerful Blessings and Weapon Mods: Try out different skills and gear to discover what playstyle suits you best.

What feedback are we looking for?
We're launching an Alpha to ensure Abyssus will deliver the best possible experience. This early test phase aims at stress-testing our servers and gathering valuable feedback about the game's features, mechanics, and overall gameplay.
To make your feedback as impactful as possible, please let us know what you think about:

 Progression: Do upgrades feel impactful?
 Difficulty: Is the challenge level enjoyable? Well paced?
 Weapons: What do you think about the balance? The gunfeel?
 Abilities: Which one did you prefer? Why?
 Gods: Again, which one did you prefer, and why? What do you think about the synergies? Do you have favorites?
 UI & UX: Does the interface feel intuitive? Is it easy to understand and read? Could some mechanics be explained better? 
You can either share your feedback on our official Discord or directly on the Steam Forums! 

Any bugs to look out for?
Because our game is still in Alpha, it unfortunately still has a few bugs here and there. None should greatly hinder your progression, but feel free to check out our list of Known Issues to look out for: https://dotemuhelp.groovehq.com/help/abyssus-technical-support-guide 

Don’t hesitate to report any technical issues you encounter on our official Discord server as well!
Please keep in mind that as the game is still a work in progress, some content may be subject to change based on testing and feedback. Your input during this stage will help us improve the experience and make Abyssus truly unforgettable.
